decisions.reason: The general bottom-side connector restriction applies to the existing main-board JST connector for the LEDs, adding a physical-placement constraint without changing its electrical interface.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: in general as less as possible on bottom side as that side will be down and hard to reach (as in the image I sent previously)

value_updates.led_connector_placement: Keep the main-board LED JST connector off the downward-facing bottom side where possible because that side is difficult to access.
